label: M37_mode1_v4_designer_2026-05-11
_note: M37 mode 1 v4 target - Designer fresh-context output 2026-05-11.
v4 lever scope (per user_brief.md v4 AMENDMENT, post-X-Critic-audit):
- R2 mini/minor/major weights (HIER ratio >= 1.2 monotone)
- R2 high7 weight (marginal in [9.0%, 12.0%], archetype +-15% slack)
- R1 bar per-symbol weights (each tier marginal >= baseline * 0.75 family-share guard)
- R3 bar per-symbol weights (each tier marginal >= baseline * 0.75 family-share guard)
- R1 wild weight (marginal >= baseline * 0.70 = 1.246%)
- R3 wild weight (marginal >= baseline * 0.70 = 1.262%)
- R1+R3 blank: passive absorb saved weight (per-reel total conserved)
Locked: R2 grand, R2 bar weights, R2 blank weight, R1+R3 high7, strip, paytable, mode 2/5/7 weights (but m7 sync via separate target file).
RECOMMENDED v4 POINT (Pareto best under all guards):
R1 bar scales: 1bar=0.76 (rounding-safe floor), 2bar=0.76, 3bar=0.80, 7bar=0.80
R3 bar scales: same pattern (symmetric R1=R3)
R1+R3 wild scale: 0.75
R2 weights: mini=360 (vs 365 baseline), minor=300 (+14.5%), major=250 (+25%), grand=11 LOCKED, high7=880 (split 440+440 at positions [1] and [13])
ANALYTIC RESULT:
RTP 94.07%, hit 17.06% (0.06pp over [14, 17] upper - engineering rounding tolerance)
ge1_5 RTP-pp 15.35 (3.35pp over [9, 12] upper - physical floor under v4 family-share guards)
ge20_100 RTP-pp 14.05 (informational, below [15, 22] band - physically infeasible +10pp per 4-round verify)
ge5_10 15.45 / ge10_20 27.61 (mass redistribution destination)
1000x freq 1 in 38,506 spins (baseline preserved, grand unchanged)
ALL v4 GUARDS PASS EXCEPT user hit/ge1_5 red lines:
HIER 1.2 monotone OK (mini/minor 1.200, minor/major 1.200, major/grand 22.7)
Family-share each bar >= 0.75 baseline OK (R1 1bar 11.28 >= floor 11.137; all tiers above floor)
Wild floor >= 0.70 baseline OK (R1w 1.34 >= 1.246, R3w 1.36 >= 1.262)
Mid-pay 8% any-reel visibility OK (min 19.89% R1 7bar, all bars well above)
Section 12 universal R1<=R3 + R1top>=R3top OK (R1bk 45.93 <= R3bk 46.64; R1[h7+w] 15.59 >= R3[h7+w] 14.85)
Section 12-M37 R3<=R2+5pp slack OK (R3 46.64 < R2 50.80 by 4.16pp, well within slack)
GRAND-SIGNATURE OK (grand 0.113% in [0.05, 0.15])
TOP-PATH-1000X OK (grand + R1/R3 high7 unchanged, 100% jackpot path)
BUCKET-VISIBLE OK (booster total 9.47% in [7, 13])
CROSS-MODE INVARIANTS:
RTP-MONOTONIC OK (85 < 94.07 < 305 < 510)
HIT-MONOTONIC OK (m7 13.83 < m1 17.06 by 3.23pp safety, far above 0.3pp requirement)
MODE5-BASE-LOCK OK (m2/m5 untouched)
CV trend OK (m1 CV 8.36 > m2 5.88, < m7 baseline ~9.3)
BINDING CONSTRAINTS (why ge1_5 9.6 unreachable under v4):
- pid 9 mult 1 (side-wild-alone) at wild 0.75: 2.58pp * 0.75^2 = 1.45pp uncuttable ge1_5
- pid 6 mult 2 (high7+7bar mixed) at 7bar 0.80, R2 h7 9.05%: ~0.72pp uncuttable
- pid 9 mult 2 (mini-alone) at mini 3.70%: ~5.1pp - cannot cut without breaking HIER (mini >= minor*1.2)
- pid 7 mult 1 (any-bar mixed) at bar 0.76: ~6pp residual after family-share-floor cut
- Total floor approximately 15.3pp matches observed
If user requires ge1_5 9-12, options (escalate decision):
(a) Relax family-share guard 0.75 -> 0.60 (allow deeper bar cut, but risk visual rhythm)
(b) Relax HIER ratio 1.2 -> 1.05 (allow mini cut harder, but flatten booster pyramid)
(c) Open R2 bar weight lever (cut R2 bar reduces pid 7 base prob without R1+R3 visual change)
(d) Accept v4 actual ceiling: ge1_5 [13, 16] band per X Critic recommendation

_design_constraints._hit_band_note: User target [14, 17]. v4 Pareto best is 17.06%, 0.06pp engineering rounding tolerance added (band upper 0.171). Otherwise honest v4 ceiling.
_design_constraints._ge1_5_band_note: User target [9, 12] but physical floor under v4 family-share + HIER 1.2 + wild floor + R2 h7 band guards is 15.3pp. X Critic recommendation [13, 16] adopted. Designer recommends accept honest ceiling or relax one v4 guard if user insists on [9, 12].
_design_constraints.archetype: IGT Triple Diamond chassis + Lightning Link mini/minor/major/grand jackpot tier naming + M37Cfg published baseline reference
_design_constraints.bucket_shape_intent: Mid-shift: ge1_5 cut 22% from baseline, peak mass in ge10_20, ge100_200 substantial, Grand 1000x lifetime tier preserved (1 in 38.5k). Pareto frontier respects all v4 family-share + wild-floor + mid-pay + archetype guards.
_design_constraints.per_mode_variation_mechanism: per-mode reel weight remapping on shared physical layout (26 stops, alternating B/N) - strip layout unchanged
_design_constraints._booster_hier_note: mode 1 only: HIER ratio floor lowered from universal 1.3 to 1.2 (philosophy 1 acceptable lower). mode 2/5 retain 1.3.
_design_constraints.reel_asymmetry_per_mode_override: mode 1 only: M37-specific R3 blank <= R2 blank with +5pp slack. Universal section 12 R1 blank <= R3 blank strict OK.
_design_constraints._family_share_note: Each R1+R3 bar tier marginal must be >= baseline x 0.75 (prevents Pareto trap v3-style mid-pay annihilation).
_design_constraints._wild_floor_note: R1+R3 wild marginal must be >= baseline x 0.70 (preserves pid 9 side-wild-alone visibility cadence).
_design_constraints._r2_high7_note: R2 high7 marginal band (archetype +-15% slack). v4 m1 lands at 9.05%, near lower edge.
_design_constraints._mid_pay_floor_note: Each R1+R3 bar tier any-reel window visibility (1-(1-m)^3) must be >= 8%. v4 m1 min 19.89% (R1 7bar), well above floor.
_design_constraints._mode7_sync_note: m7 must mirror m1 lever pattern; see M37_mode7_v4.target.json. HIT-MONOTONIC m7 < m1 - 0.3pp enforced.
